messages:
Diego (AE): Orbit renewal ask: 12mo extension, commit 180M/mo, asking for 25% off current unit price and 30-day PO. Need fast track for launch.
Marcel (SalesOps): 25% is out of band for renewals. Need Deal Desk packet and margin calc.
Priya (CS): They also want a Dedicated POC with latency SLA and KV cache persistence 1. That changes pricing (reserved capacity).
Eve (Solutions Eng): Rough sizing: 4x A10G, persistent volumes needed. Estimated reserved cost ~ $18k/mo for ramp.
Jo (Legal): 30-day payment + discount needs exec sign-off and DPA review. We can provide SOC2 under NDA.
dealbot: Approval request created DD-7790  approvers: Head Sales, Finance, Legal.
Marcel (SalesOps): Proposal: structured discount 20% + 6% prepay credit (effective ~24%) and 45-day net unless prepay. That lowers cash risk.
Diego (AE): I'll ask Orbit if prepay is possible. Target close EOD Friday.
Orbit (customer): We can consider prepay if the pricing and Dedicated POC are confirmed this week. Launch date is locked.
Priya (CS): I'll prepare security Q&A and request SOC2 NDA today.
Marcel (SalesOps): Submitting packet now with margin impact (-9%). Vote requested by 12:00 PST tomorrow.
Diego (AE): If declined propose fallback: 15% + 3mo burst credit. Will update after Deal Desk.
